about:
Rountree Electric Supply Co., doing business as Rountree Outdoors, is based in Selma, Alabama. The company operates an e-commerce store focused on outdoor apparel and gear, accessible at rountreealabama.com.

The retailer stocks a range of hunting, fishing, and casual wear, including shorts, t-shirts, and youth sizes. Brands carried include Southern Marsh, Fish Hippie, Southern Point, Lews, Drake Waterfowl, and Strike King. The site organizes products into departments such as Men's Apparel, Hunting Apparel, and Fishing. Orders are fulfilled from its Selma location with a stated policy of shipping within two business days via USPS, UPS, or FedEx. The site also displays pricing in multiple currencies including USD, CAD, EUR, and others.

The store serves individual consumers — hunters, anglers, and outdoor enthusiasts — through its online shop. No industrial or wholesale customer segments are described in the available information.

Rountree Outdoors promotes free standard shipping on orders over $50 and emphasizes quick dispatch as a point of differentiation.
